name: curlsmith
description: Firefox-first local API capture and styled cURL generator extension.

scripts.check:syntax: find extension -name '*.js' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check && node --check extension/test/integration/server.mjs
scripts.package:extension: web-ext build --source-dir extension --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --overwrite-dest --ignore-files test docs .webextensionignore
scripts.check: npm test && npm run check:syntax && npm run lint:web-ext
